summary: Full-stack testing of CAD Assist (FastAPI + SQLite + React). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass covering health, upload+auto-process for both samples, jobs list, preview JPEG, DXF download, reprocess, delete, unsupported-extension validation, seeded rules, correction-creates-rule, rule patch toggle, rule delete. Frontend: home page, upload zone, system panel (backend online, tesseract ready, fitz ready, sqlite local), drag-drop upload via hidden input, jobs-table population, navigation to /job/:id, geometry-canvas + layer-panel (GEOMETRY/TEXT/DIMENSIONS/UNCERTAIN), download-dxf button, correction-panel-empty initial state, correction-panel renders fully when an uncertain item is clicked (showing ID, confidence, data, apply-similar-toggle, action-to-circle, action-mark-certain, action-delete), /rules page with rules-table + rule-toggle/rule-delete buttons, /about page with pipeline description, back-home navigation. No JS pageerrors detected.

ui_bugs.issue: SVG entity click target is the stroke only (fill="none"). Clicking the visual center of an arc/circle/polyline lands inside the bounding box but on transparent area, so the entity click does not register and the correction panel does not open. Users have a similar usability problem with thin strokes. Workaround in the UI is the right-side 'Uncertain Items' list which works correctly.

action_items: Improve SVG entity hit-area in GeometryCanvas: use pointer-events='visibleStroke' (already non-fill) AND add a transparent thicker hit overlay (e.g., second element with stroke='transparent', strokeWidth=10/scale, pointerEvents='stroke') so users can click thin lines/arcs reliably. The right-rail uncertain list already works as an alternative.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: pipeline.run_job is dispatched via loop.run_in_executor(None, ...) without awaiting / tracking the future. Errors raised inside run_job won't surface unless captured internally; verified jobs do reach status='done' via DB updates so it's working but unhandled exceptions could silently log only.
Default CORS allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically inconsistent (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). Acceptable for local-first app but worth tightening.
delete_job: filesystem cleanup wrapped in single try/except Exception:pass swallows errors; would help to log warnings.
GeometryCanvas hit-area issue noted in frontend_issues; consider invisible stroke overlay for clickability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required testids present and flows working; one UX concern flagged)

seed_data_creation: Two jobs uploaded and then deleted by the backend test cleanup phase. Three jobs from manual frontend test remain in DB (geometry_demo.png x2, mechanical_part.png) and are visible on home jobs-table.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers full CRUD + pipeline. Pipeline takes ~3-7s per sample; _wait_for_done timeout=60s is sufficient. Note: DB get_entities filters out deleted=1 entities by default (include_deleted=False). The DXF starts with '0\nSECTION' (no leading two spaces). Frontend SVG entity clicks miss because fill=none — use the uncertain-items list selector or a JS dispatchEvent to trigger CorrectionPanel programmatically.
rca of the issue: GeometryCanvas: each entity is rendered as a single SVG primitive with fill='none'. Playwright (and real users) clicking near a hollow shape may miss the stroke. Fix: render a second invisible primitive with the same geometry, stroke='transparent', strokeWidth large (e.g., 10/view.scale), pointerEvents='stroke', sharing the same onClick handler — preserves visual fidelity while expanding hit area.
